text:
paul: FYI vendor (EdgeCloud Inc) issued a $12,300 credit memo for July usage — they overbilled on a discounted tier. It applied to July invoices but references usage across May-July. Need month-end treatment.
nina: Do we know if credits are refundable or applied against future invoices?
paul: It's a credit memo (applied to AR). No cash refund. They included a PDF showing per-month allocations: May $2,500, June $4,300, July $5,500.
rahul: Sounds like we need to unwind revenue in the months where overbilling occurred. Under ASC 606, reduce revenue in the period of performance. That implies restating June/May if already closed, or posting a prior-period adjustment.
paul: June is closed and audited. We can't restate without legal/audit sign-off. What interim posting can we do for month-end?
nina: Practical approach: record a July period adjustment but disclose as a prior-period correction in the close memo. For bookkeeping, we can post a Contra-Revenue accrual in July and tag it for audit review.
rahul: Proposed JE for July (accrual until audit decision):
```
Date: 2024-07-31
Dr. 5400 - Sales Returns & Allowances         12,300
   Cr. 2300 - Accrued Credit Memos Liab.       12,300
Narrative: Accrual for EdgeCloud credit memo pending allocation approval and audit guidance.
```
paul: If auditors require restatement for May/June, we'll reclass from the accrual into the historical revenue reversal entries then.
tax-bot: Note: If revenue is reduced for prior periods, tax filings may be impacted. Please loop in tax ops for R&E treatment.
rahul: Also need to update revenue schedules and ARR impact. Suggest tagging all entries with vendor id EC-449 and include PDF in the audit folder.
paul: Who will create the memo? I'll draft the client communication and upload the credit PDF. Nina can you draft the accounting memo for auditors?
nina: On it. I'll include recommended options: (1) immediate accrual + disclose; (2) restate prior periods if required by audit; (3) treat as deferred credit if customer requests future offset (not the case here).
acct-bot: Reminder: close subledger cutoff is 18:00 PT. Any JEs after that flow next month.
paul: We'll aim to upload the JE by 16:00 PT. Rahul, can you confirm ARR impact calc?
rahul: Will calculate ARR delta (estimated $9k annualized impact) and post to the close tracker.
nina: Also tagging this thread "rev-rec-vendor-credit" for reporting.
paul: Thanks team. If audit pushes restatement, we'll coordinate with legal and tax. For now post accrual JE and include vendor allocation PDF in the audit package.
